story_type: crewed capsule reentry streak, drogues and mains, splashdown, long-range tracking camera
hook: That streak of fire is four people coming home.
narration: That streak of fire is four people falling home from the space station.
Crew-12 had undocked the day before. Now their Dragon capsule was dropping in over the Pacific.
Air piles up in front of the heat shield and glows, and the shield slowly burns away to carry that heat off.
Next came two small drogue parachutes, to slow the capsule and keep it steady.
Then the four main parachutes opened.
Inside were NASA's Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway, Sophie Adenot of the European Space Agency, and cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev.
Then the ocean came up to meet them.
outcome: Crew-12 splashed down off the coast of California.
title: Crew-12 falls home as a streak of fire
description:
On Oct. 8, 2026, NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway, ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot and Roscosmos cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev splashed down off the coast of California in their SpaceX Dragon, the day after undocking from the International Space Station.
